column10: Also used as a line separator by Microsoft Word and Powerpoint which use it to contrast with the character used as a paragraph separator (sources: http://stackoverflow.com/questions/3380538/what-is-a-vertical-tab http://unicode.org/reports/tr13/tr13-9.html )

This is the Unicode U+0085. May semantically indicate a new paragraph. To indicate unambiguously a new line without a new paragraph, use 295 New line within paragraph. To indicate unambiguously a new paragraph, use 294 Paragraph separator.
This is the ASCII/Unicode 13 (0x0D). Used as a paragraph separator by Microsoft Word and Powerpoint (source: https://web.archive.org/web/20080325092316/http://support.microsoft.com/kb/59096).
